definitions.explanation: An earnest, emotional plea or request, often made from a position of weakness or desperation. Stronger and more emotional than a simple request.

examples.japanese: {哀願|あいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{哀願|あいがん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The child said "please" in a pleading tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{哀願|あいがん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{聞|き}き{入|い}れて→聞き入れる：04586_kikiireru⟧⟦もらえなかった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: He pleaded tearfully, but his plea was not accepted.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({哀願|あいがん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) or as a noun modifier. Carries a strong emotional nuance — the person is desperately begging. Common in literary and dramatic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {哀願|あいがん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to plead, to implore)
- {哀願|あいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (pleading eyes)
- {哀願|あいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (pleading voice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{懇願|こんがん}→懇願：12686_kongan⟧: earnest entreaty — similar intensity, slightly more formal
- ⟦{嘆願|たんがん}→嘆願：21595_tangan⟧: petition, appeal — more formal, often used for official requests
